games.name: Rolling Riches 💰
games.desc:
🚀 Welcome to Rolling Riches 💰!

Press E to hop into your rock and start rolling — steer with W-A-D!

Race your custom boulder down an epic mountain filled with exciting obstacles, awesome jumps, and explosive fun! 🪨💥

🎮 How to Play:
- Roll your rock down the hill, smash through trees, dodge obstacles, and cause thrilling explosions!
- Earn cash every second you roll, and unlock bigger, cooler, crazier boulders!
- Invite your friends—each friend boosts your multiplier, speeding up your earnings!

⭐ Premium Perks:
- Exclusive multiplier for Premium members—level up even faster!

🏆 Can you reach the finish line and become the richest roller on the leaderboard?

If you love incremental games, mountain racing, destruction, obstacle-smashing action, and physics-based adventures, simulation, incremental simulation, Rolling Riches 💰 is perfect for you!

Previously known as "Roll a Rock Down the Hill".

🔓 Private Servers are now FREE — play with your friends anytime! 🎉
